title: Hanasato Minori — Let's Do A Fan Meeting!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: During break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be great to do an event where we can meet all of you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. I want to meet all of our fans too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If we're going to do an event, it'd be nice to also do a meet and greet and a mini-concert.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A meet and greet and a mini-concert...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A real-life event...
How do we make it so everyone can enjoy it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! We could exchange presents and stuff since it'll take place on Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure how Christmassy we can make this event, but I'll add it to my list of ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, this should be enough ideas in addition to everything I came up with yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll have to find a venue, hire staff and work little by little to make it a reality...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'd be nice to perform at a large venue, but we'd have to think about how to actually book it and how many people will actually come to see us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(A venue and staff...
I wish I could help with that somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Airi and Haruka have pretty much been taking care of all the ideas for our streams.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (So if we are going to put on an actual event, I need to start finding ways to contribute too!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough practice for today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, great practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, there's something I'd like to discuss with all of you. Mind if we talk while we rest?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to know more about what we need to do and what kind of schedule we're looking at if we really do want to put on an event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a vague idea of what goes on during meet and greets, mini-concerts and when CDs go on sale, but I don't really know what happens before all that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
We haven't really talked about that much, have we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also... I may not be the best person to ask since we're looking to do a much more modest event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. ASRUN's nationwide tours saw tens of thousands of fans gather for each event, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! What we need to do is gonna change based on the scale of our event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bullseye!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could use the mini-concert I did at the mall with QT as an example. Wanna know more about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means we get to hear all about what happened behind the scenes that time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's start with how our manager told us that we'd be a mini-concert to celebrate our CD going on sale about two months in advance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our agency, along with the production company that helped us plan everything, pretty much focused on the core of the event, like sales quotas for CDs and where we'd be performing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Big or small, it's important to have a set goal in mind when preparing for an event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. Lemme jot that down...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How did you practice for it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All the QT members would usually meet after work and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, there was only so much we could do in a day, but we also had two months to prepare for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On the day of, we met with the staff, our manager, our contacts from the mall...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, the lead from the production company, some of their event staff and the MC too... So like seven or eight people in total.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That sounds like so few!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, we didn't even need that many. I mean, they even found an MC who could set the stage for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're usually very good at drawing everybody in, especially the people at the front, and warming up the crowd by doing light introductions for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they can make a huge difference.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Cheerful * Days usually had an MC do that for us at the start of our shows when we were just debuting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like both of your groups' agencies really wanted you to succeed. I mean, it's pretty rare to have an MC for a mini-concert like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I have a question about setting everything up at a venue. Does the staff take care of all of that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do.
But that's not all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of having to move everybody around in an orderly manner, they have to make sure people aren't blocking any paths.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And once a show's over, they have to help sell CDs and merch. That staff takes care of all the crowd control so we can focus on our meet and greet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Setting up a venue, crowd control, clearing paths, selling CDs and merch... They all juggle so much at once.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, which is why we can get away with having just a few for an event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But that's about it from me.
I wish I could tell you more about how they actually set up equipment and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Equipment setup? For the stage?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. It's always nice to be able to use a stage that's mostly set up to begin with...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it might take a while to explain everything if we go down this rabbit hole.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure we'll still have time to explain this after we know more about what we'll be doing for our event.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me neither!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's so much to do, but I'm really excited about being able to put on an actual event!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. We should probably start talking about what we'd like to do soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we have a quick discussion about that before we head home?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna start! I came up with lots and lots of ideas!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Way to take the initiative!
But first, we should get changed before we all end up catching a cold.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
